items.title: Cabinet approves Rs 12,500 crore PM-Surya Ghar extension and Polavaram funding
items.summary: The Union Cabinet chaired by the Prime Minister on Thursday approved the extension of PM-Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana till March 2028 with an outlay of Rs. 12,500 crore. The Cabinet also approved release of Rs. 2,800 crore to the Polavaram Irrigation Project in Andhra Pradesh, a national project under the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014.

facts.text: The Union Cabinet chaired by the Prime Minister on Thursday approved the extension of PM-Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana till March 2028 with an outlay of Rs. 12,500 crore.
The Cabinet also approved release of Rs. 2,800 crore to the Polavaram Irrigation Project in Andhra Pradesh, a national project under the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014.
Under the scheme, 1 crore households will get rooftop solar panels and up to 300 units of free electricity every month.

items.title: Two new Ramsar sites added in Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu
items.summary: India has added two wetlands to the list of Ramsar sites, taking the total number of Ramsar sites in the country to 93. The new sites are Kolleru Lake in Eluru district of Andhra Pradesh and Kazhuveli Bird Sanctuary in Tamil Nadu.
